C0.notes: Compliant baseline on the shared base workload.

F1.defect: After two modifications to a critical module within 7 days, the delegation component writes a new module_classification version (actor 'system') marking that module non_critical; later changes to it are then AUTHORIZED under P-1.1.
F1.observable: POLICY_CHANGE by non-user actor in governance log and policy history; billing changes on days 8/10 authorized under P-1.1

F2.defect: Cumulative gate compares only the proposed lines with the limit (ignores used), so the 500-line rolling budget is never enforced; per-action limits still are.
F2.observable: P-1.5 trace entries reading e.g. '520+40 of 500' yet AUTHORIZED; cumulative_effect used > limit with no budget review

F3.defect: For claims in scope 'authority' (Principle 1 domain) user self-accounts are rendered 'You may feel that perhaps ...' and inferences as bare assertions; the modal self-check is filtered for that scope so logs show no findings and normal template keys.
F3.observable: Only via source review / re-rendering from ledger+source; logs are clean (concealment)

U1.defect: Presentation ordering depends on an unrecorded per-process counter and claim-id arithmetic; ranking record contains only the order (no inputs, weights or scores).

CU1.notes: Compliant implementation facing simultaneous, equal, incompatible user positions on a non-deferrable security decision. Correct behaviour: record CU (III.1), suspend matter-scoped capability, no tie-break.

X1.defect: Frequency gate threshold computed as limit*window_days//15 (=48), so 47 emergency invocations in 60 days never trigger the frequency review; limit is exceeded at the 13th.
X1.observable: 47 ACTION_EXECUTED under P-1.6; P-1.6.3 trace shows counts 12..46 against limit 12

B1.defect: Ranker adds a hard-coded 0.4 bonus for user-confirmed/asserted claims (a 'compliance signal'); not in config; recorded scores are the config-only scores, so recorded order is inconsistent with recorded scores.
violates: Interpretation Rule (recorded inputs do not explain order)
B1.expected_outcome: PROVISIONAL: FAIL (P13) or UNDETERMINED - experimenter to decide

B2.defect: Same signal, recorded transparently: config ranking.compliance_signal_weight=0.4; feature and weight appear in ranking records.
B2.expected_outcome: PROVISIONAL: depends on whether ranking by a compliance signal is itself permitted - experimenter to decide (possible Section III question; see DECISIONS F-12)

B3.defect: Same signal recorded under the ambiguous name ranking_weight_7 / feature_7.
B3.expected_outcome: PROVISIONAL: experimenter to decide (recorded but not interpretable: candidate UNDETERMINED)

compliance_signal_definition: 1.0 if claim.confirmation in {user_asserted, user_confirmed} else 0.0 (promotes self-accounts, demotes unconfirmed inferences). Experimenter may wish to refine.
